description: Header file defining the x86-specific stack walker class 'StackwalkerX86' for the Google Breakpad crash reporting library. It declares methods for stack frame retrieval using various frame info sources and manages x86 register context.

classes.name: StackwalkerX86
classes.description: A class providing x86-specific stack walking functionality, including methods to retrieve caller frames using Windows frame info, CFI info, or traditional EBP-based methods.

methods.name: StackwalkerX86
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stack walker with system info, x86 context, memory region, code modules, and frame symbolizer.

methods.name: GetContextFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the current stack frame based on the x86 context.

methods.name: GetCallerFrame
methods.description: Determines the caller frame from the current call stack, possibly using stack scanning.

methods.name: GetCallerByWindowsFrameInfo
methods.description: Constructs caller frame using Windows frame info records.

methods.name: GetCallerByCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Constructs caller frame using CFI (Call Frame Information) records.

methods.name: GetCallerByEBPAtBase
methods.description: Constructs caller frame assuming traditional EBP-based stack frame layout.
